templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S4 Cubic graphs
templates.text: For $y = x^3$, what happens to $y$ when $x$ is negative? Describe the shape of the graph.
templates.answer: $y$ is negative for negative $x$ ([[-k * k * k]] when $x = -[[k]]$); the graph rises from bottom left to top right through the origin with a flat point at the origin

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S4 Cubic graphs
templates.text: Complete the table for $y = x^3 - [[b]]x$ and write down the values of $x$ in the table where $y = 0$. Is the graph symmetrical about the origin? (4 marks)
templates.answer: $y = 0$ when $x = 0$ [[b == 1|if: and x = ±1/ ]][[b == 4|if: and x = ±2/ ]][[b == 9|if: and x = ±3/ ]]; yes, it has rotational symmetry about the origin

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S5 Reciprocal graphs
templates.text: Which graph shape belongs to $y = \frac{[[k]]}{x}$, $y = [[k]]^x$ and $y = [[k]]x$? Choose from: straight line, curve that falls and never touches the axes, curve that rises faster and faster.
templates.answer: $y = [[k]]x$ straight line; $y = \frac{[[k]]}{x}$ falling curve; $y = [[k]]^x$ rises faster and faster

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S6 Recognise and sketch graphs
templates.text: What shape is the graph of [[k == 0|if:y = 2x + 3/]][[k == 1|if:y = x² + 4/]][[k == 2|if:y = 6 ÷ x/]][[k == 3|if:y = x³ - 2/]]?
templates.answer: [[k == 0|if:a straight line/]][[k == 1|if:a U-shaped curve (parabola)/]][[k == 2|if:a curve with two separate branches (hyperbola)/]][[k == 3|if:an S-shaped curve/]]

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S6 Recognise and sketch graphs
templates.text: Where does the graph of [[k == 0|if:y = 2x + 3/]][[k == 1|if:y = x² + 4/]][[k == 2|if:y = 6 ÷ x/]][[k == 3|if:y = x³ - 2/]] cross the $y$-axis (if it does)?
templates.answer: [[k == 0|if:(0, 3)/]][[k == 1|if:(0, 4)/]][[k == 2|if:it never crosses the y-axis (x cannot be 0)/]][[k == 3|if:(0, -2)/]]

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B1 Functions and graphs · S6 Recognise and sketch graphs
templates.text: Sketch the graph of $y = x^2 - [[c]]$ and write down its line of symmetry, the minimum point and where it crosses the $y$-axis. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Line of symmetry $x = 0$; minimum (0, [[-c]]); crosses the $y$-axis at (0, [[-c]])
